title: Everything I've built, on one map
intro: Placed by what each project is about, the way an embedding model would. Each small dot is one of 165 freelance projects.
footnote: Positions and scores come from embeddings of each project write-up.

points.name: Mavera
points.desc: AI market-intelligence platform. I built it end to end, then led the developers who joined.

points.name: Mave Agent
points.desc: Tool calling, retrieval and streaming in a native app written in Rust with Tauri.

points.name: MCP servers
points.desc: Servers and jobs the agent calls to read reports, meetings and videos.

points.name: AIWrappers
points.desc: Describe a tool in plain words and an agent builds it as a web app on your own domain.

points.name: Bina.ai
points.desc: Briefs for litigation funders, with every quote checked word for word against the ruling.

points.name: Kubernetes
points.desc: Containerised services on AWS that I operated as the platform grew.

points.name: Caracat at LIP6
points.desc: A Rust traceroute engine validated against its C++ predecessor, supervised by Timur Friedman.

points.name: CUDA and MPI
points.desc: GPU programming and parallel computing this year. Top of the class in System Design last year.

points.name: BirdCLEF+
points.desc: Classical ML on 35.5K recordings of 206 bird species, five models benchmarked.

points.name: Aveksana
points.desc: The document editor researchers use to write theses and proposals.

points.name: Gourmet Gulf
points.desc: Operations platform for a restaurant group across the UAE, Qatar and Saudi Arabia.

points.name: 165 freelance projects
points.desc: Web and AI builds for international clients, from voice-AI receptionists to RAG chatbots.

realEmbeddings: Phase 2 (optional): write a 100-200 word description per point, embed with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 at build time, project to 2D with UMAP, and use cosine similarity for neighbours. Keep the hand-set positions as the fallback and keep cluster labels readable.
